name: Cipher Dalgaard
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 32, scars map her face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a fixer out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom's reputation — and a price for silence
A Tier 4 executive offers Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Aminata Tarasov-Yiadom represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: East Asian, Indigenous American, Pacific Islander, Hispanic/Latin American, and South Asian—a striking synthesis of pan-Pacific and continental lineages. Features reflect the dominant East Asian structure (35.4%) blended with strong Indigenous American bone structure (20.8%), warm Pacific Islander coloring (19.0%), and subtle South Asian undertones (8.1%), with a final thread of Hispanic/Latin American heritage (16.7%) adding warmth and dimension.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy, muscular-stocky, carries weight with deliberate control — built for power and endurance rather than speed
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; practical, no vanity
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep bronze with golden undertones; sun-weathered with rich saturation that speaks to Pacific Islander and Indigenous American heritage, layered with the slightly warmer cast of East Asian and South Asian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Strong, angular face with pronounced cheekbones reflecting Indigenous American structure; slightly broader at the temples in East Asian pattern; warm bronze complexion with faint freckling across nose and shoulders; weathered and lean-faced. Multiple fine scars across jawline and left temple; no makeup, minimal grooming beyond function.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel scars running from left cheekbone to jawline, thin and precise as blade work
Scar tissue along right forearm from smartgun link installation, visible chrome edges catching light
Burn scar on inside of left wrist, roughly circular, old and faded
Thin white line running from right eyebrow through temple to hairline
Knuckle scars on both hands, the wear of hand-to-hand work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Smartgun link mounted in right forearm with visible chrome interface plates and neural connector ports; metallic silver sheen at wrist joint; occasional faint LED glow at interface when systems active
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, no wasted motion; stands with weight balanced on balls of feet, ready to shift; shoulders set forward slightly; resting expression is watchful, not hostile but not welcoming
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: reinforced synthetic jacket in matte charcoal over tech-wear underlayer with visible connector ports; cargo pants with multiple tool pockets and armor plating at knees and hips; worn steel-toed boots with grip soles; minimal jewelry except functional smartwatch on left wrist; no corporate branding, all utility
